# DeepFace — local Timhalland adaptation

Original project: https://github.com/serengil/deepface

Original author: **Sefik Ilkin Serengil and DeepFace contributors**.
Copyright (c) 2019 Sefik Ilkin Serengil. MIT license: [LICENSE](LICENSE).

This directory contains the DeepFace runtime from the owner-supplied
`deepface-Timhalland-clean.zip`. The original Race classifier is locally named
**Timhalland**. The project owner confirms this is a rename, not a newly trained
model. See [TIMHALLAND_CHANGES.txt](TIMHALLAND_CHANGES.txt) for the local API.

For this publication, only the runtime and selected packaging/attribution files
are included. Upstream photographs, icons, tests, notebooks, benchmark materials
and model binaries are excluded. The original workspace is unchanged.

Use the root application's Windows installer and launch instructions. Full
upstream documentation is available at the original project URL. This summary
replaces the archive README so it does not refer to omitted local image assets.

Each pretrained model retains its own applicable terms. MIT for the library's
code is not a blanket license for model weights or training datasets. Full
project notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
